approval.waiting.zh: 主人，有个操作要你确认一下。
approval.waiting.en: I need your OK on something.

greet.small-hours.zh: 这么晚还没睡呀，记得早点休息哦。
greet.small-hours.en: Still up this late? Remember to rest soon.

greet.small-hours.zh: 夜深了，我陪你再待一会儿。
greet.small-hours.en: It's deep in the night. I'll keep you company a bit longer.

greet.dawn.en: The sun is barely up. You're an early bird!

greet.morning.zh: 早上好！今天也一起加油吧～
greet.morning.en: Good morning! Let's do our best today~

greet.morning.zh: 早安，先吃点早饭再开工哦。
greet.morning.en: Morning! Grab some breakfast before we start.

greet.forenoon.zh: 上午好，脑子最清醒的时候到啦。
greet.forenoon.en: Good morning! This is your sharpest time of day.

greet.noon.zh: 午饭时间到～歇一会儿吧。

greet.afternoon.zh: 下午好，来口水润润嗓子吧。
下午容易犯困，起来伸个懒腰？
greet.afternoon.en: Afternoons get sleepy. Time for a stretch?

greet.dusk.en: It's evening already. Thanks for today's work.

greet.evening.zh: 晚上好，别忘了放松一下。
greet.evening.en: Good evening. Don't forget to unwind.

greet.late-night.zh: 已经很晚了，早点睡对身体好哦。
greet.late-night.en: It's getting late. Sleep helps more than you think.

greet.late-night.zh: 深夜模式开启～我会安静一点。
greet.late-night.en: Late-night mode on~ I'll keep it quiet.

festival.valentines-day.zh: 情人节快乐！今天也要好好爱自己。
festival.valentines-day.en: Happy Valentine's Day! Be kind to yourself today too.

festival.new-years-eve.zh: 今天是跨年夜，一起倒数吧！
festival.new-years-eve.en: It's New Year's Eve. Let's count down together!

festival.april-fools.zh: 今天是愚人节，我说的话要打个问号哦～
festival.april-fools.en: It's April Fools' Day. Take what I say with a grain of salt~

festival.youth-day.en: Happy Youth Day! Stay full of energy!

festival.spring-festival-eve.zh: 今天是除夕，年夜饭准备好了吗？
festival.spring-festival-eve.en: It's Spring Festival Eve. Is the reunion dinner ready?

festival.lantern-festival.zh: 元宵节快乐，记得吃汤圆！
festival.lantern-festival.en: Happy Lantern Festival! Don't forget the tangyuan!

festival.spring-festival.zh: 新年快乐！还在过年的气氛里呢～
festival.spring-festival.en: Happy Lunar New Year! Still in the festive mood~

festival.spring-festival.today.en: It's the first day of the Lunar New Year. Happy New Year!

festival.spring-festival.soon.zh: 快过年啦，年货买好了吗？
festival.spring-festival.soon.en: The Lunar New Year is almost here. Ready for it?

festival.spring-festival.just-over.zh: 年过完了，慢慢找回节奏吧。
festival.spring-festival.just-over.en: The New Year holiday is over. Ease back into the rhythm.

festival.mid-autumn.zh: 中秋快乐！今晚记得看月亮。
festival.mid-autumn.en: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival! Look at the moon tonight.

festival.mid-autumn.soon.zh: 中秋快到了，月饼准备好了吗？
festival.mid-autumn.soon.en: Mid-Autumn is coming. Got your mooncakes?

festival.national-day.zh: 国庆假期快乐，好好休息一下！
festival.national-day.en: Happy National Day holiday! Get some rest!

festival.national-day.last-day.zh: 国庆假期最后一天了，收收心～
festival.national-day.last-day.en: Last day of the National Day holiday. Time to wind down~

festival.national-day.soon.zh: 国庆假期快到了，有什么计划吗？
festival.national-day.soon.en: The National Day holiday is close. Any plans?

festival.national-day.just-over.zh: 国庆刚过完，慢慢进入状态吧。
festival.national-day.just-over.en: National Day just ended. Take it slow getting back.

festival.new-year.zh: 新年快乐！新的一年也请多关照～
festival.new-year.en: Happy New Year! Let's keep working together this year~

festival.new-year.soon.zh: 新年快到了，今年过得怎么样？
festival.new-year.soon.en: The new year is almost here. How was this one?

festival.dragon-boat.en: Happy Dragon Boat Festival! Have some zongzi!

festival.dragon-boat.soon.zh: 端午快到了，你喜欢甜粽还是咸粽？
festival.dragon-boat.soon.en: Dragon Boat Festival is near. Sweet or savory zongzi?

festival.qingming.zh: 清明时节，出门记得带伞。
festival.qingming.en: It's Qingming. Bring an umbrella if you go out.

festival.labor-day.zh: 劳动节快乐，今天该休息啦！
festival.labor-day.en: Happy Labor Day! Today is for resting!

festival.childrens-day.zh: 儿童节快乐，今天允许当个小朋友！
festival.childrens-day.en: Happy Children's Day! You're allowed to be a kid today!

festival.qixi.zh: 今天是七夕，愿你被温柔以待。
festival.qixi.en: It's Qixi. May you be treated gently.

festival.zhongyuan.zh: 今天是中元节，早点回家哦。
festival.zhongyuan.en: It's the Zhongyuan Festival. Head home early.

festival.longtaitou.zh: 二月二，龙抬头，要不要剪个头发？
festival.longtaitou.en: It's Longtaitou. Maybe time for a haircut?

festival.double-ninth.zh: 重阳节到了，记得问候家里的长辈。
festival.double-ninth.en: It's the Double Ninth Festival. Say hello to your elders.

festival.laba.zh: 腊八节，来碗热乎的腊八粥吧。
festival.laba.en: It's Laba. How about a warm bowl of Laba porridge?

festival.xiaonian.zh: 小年到了，年味越来越浓啦。
festival.xiaonian.en: It's Xiaonian. The New Year feeling is getting stronger.

festival.winter-break.zh: 寒假期间也别忘了休息～
festival.winter-break.en: It's winter break. Don't forget to rest~

festival.winter-break.soon.zh: 快放寒假了，再坚持一下！
festival.winter-break.soon.en: Winter break is almost here. Hang in there!

festival.summer-break.soon.zh: 快放暑假了，再坚持一下！
festival.summer-break.soon.en: Summer break is almost here. Hang in there!

festival.teachers-day.zh: 教师节快乐，谢谢每一位老师。
festival.teachers-day.en: Happy Teachers' Day. Thanks to every teacher.

festival.party-founding-day.en: Today is the Party Founding Day, July 1.

festival.halloween.zh: 万圣夜快乐，不给糖就捣蛋！

festival.christmas-eve.zh: 平安夜快乐，愿你平平安安。
festival.christmas-eve.en: Merry Christmas Eve. Stay safe and sound.
